origin.origins_backgrounds_two.greenwitc: Leɛmeṛ yesɛan azal n wuɛekkaz iwakken ad yefk ayen yelhan.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.hunter.de: Iɛsekṛiyen sselmaden-d s tḥila n lbabuṛ.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.trader.de: Ixeddamen-nsen ssnen abrid-nsen iwakken ad beddlen lfayda.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.deep_mine: Acḥal yezmer ad uɣalen d iɛebbaṛ n lqayen.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.miner.des: Ixeddmen seddaw yiwet n Ssid-iw, yesselmad-iten s yiman-iw s yiman-iw, neɣ ad qqim deg weɣṛum.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.blacksmit: D ayen yeɛnan kra n yemdanen i tesɛam leslaḥ n ddunit.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.disenchan: Aɣeṭṭas n wid ur nesɛi ara ṣṣifa n Sidi Ṛebbi ad ițțunefkent tismin ur nesɛi ara.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.cook.name: Lfayda n tečča
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.cook.desc: Axaṭer mačči d aqeṛṛuy-nsen, lameɛna ur k-zmir ara a kkun-yesseḥsen ; mbla ccehwat !
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.sentry.de: Ilaq ad țțuɛaqben aṭas, lameɛna ad ṛuḥen aṭas n lweqt.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.bounty_hu: Ma yella teḥwaǧem lmut, a t-id-fken.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.acrobat.d: Ayen ur nesɛi lfayda i yiwen n tnefsit
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.butcher.d: Ssnen amek ara sen-yeggren mbla lqut.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.street_ra: Megren deg iberdan, fehmen ad ssiwḍen iẓekwan-nsen.
Imezdaɣ n tẓurin tuɣal d ifassen tis snat.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.angler.de: Ma yella si teflukt neɣ si lebḥeṛ, yiwen n win akken i d-yețțunefk Sidi Ṛebbi aṭas n win yelhan.
